list: Official 55-trophy list as published at launch (19 November 2026); names, descriptions and grades as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles and reported by Push Square, 18 November 2026.

listSources.label: Push Square: GTA 6 PS5 Trophies Revealed (18 Nov 2026, citing Exophase)
Output Lag: GTA 6 Trophy List, all 55
GTA Vice City Hub: GTA 6 Achievements

note: Guides are written for this entry, in my own words. Where a trophy's exact trigger was still unconfirmed at launch, the guide says so instead of guessing. Methods that launch-week guides reported are paraphrased here and cited beside each trophy.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. It pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap in this guide and this one takes care of itself.

sources.label: Push Square: 55 trophies incl. Platinum (via Exophase)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so this pops in the opening hour — just play the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story only — keep playing the main missions and it pops at the end of the chapter. Do Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude) before the chapter ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story only — the same as the other chapter trophies: play the main missions through to the chapter's end.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story only. Watch for the time-sensitive stranger race in this chapter (see Strangers & Freaks) before you move on.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story only — the last chapter trophy before the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story only — this gold pops when the finale ends. The official description names no mission, and no launch-week guide gave a different trigger.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. Story only — play the mission when it appears in the story and the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. Story only — the trophy pops when the heist mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. Story only — the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. Story only — the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. Story only — the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story only — the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: This is the long one: it needs every story mission, stranger strand, activity, collectible and challenge the game's 100% checklist tracks — GTA Vice City Hub lists 35 tasks on its checklist. Leave it for last and use this guide's tracker to sweep up whatever is left.

sources.label: GTA Vice City Hub: GTA 6 Achievements (35-task checklist)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts add up across the whole game, so drive hard whenever you travel — jumps, near misses and long airtime all feed the count — and mop up the rest by chaining jumps after the story.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — all 9 types. Sample everything the game offers (races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games and the rest) rather than grinding one thing; one try of each is enough.

sources.label: GTA Bay: GTA 6 Activities — what Rockstar has shown

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Every challenge, at gold — all 42 of them. Learn each range's weapon and par time, and expect this to take several sessions. It is the hardest activity trophy on the list.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: A win at each of the 14 locations counts; smooth, tight lines beat raw speed on the twisty courses.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Different races, not the same one 20 times — work through the race types across the map.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him — steady reeling beats rushing the line.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade game and play it through to the end — one finished game is all it takes.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Play Andy's strand through to its last mission — side-story finales pop when their final mission ends.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same pattern as the other character finales: Kenton's strand, through to its final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand, through to its final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: At risk, not confirmed missable: one strand race in Chapter 3 (Race Against Yago) is time-sensitive. Do it the moment it appears.
trophies.guide: Eight strands in total. Warning: one strand race in Chapter 3 (Race Against Yago) is time-sensitive — do it the moment it appears, or it may be gone for that playthrough. The rest can wait until after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand, through to its final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand, through to its final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: MISSABLE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears once the chapter ends. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops.
trophies.guide: All 18 spots. MISSABLE: Lucia's balcony meditation is only available during Chapter 1 and disappears once the chapter ends. Do it in Chapter 1, before moving on, and keep a Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's hunting strand — the unique animal is the end of it. The strand runs through the hunting grounds around Mount Kalaga, per GTA Bay's activity notes.

sources.label: GTA Bay: GTA 6 Activities — Mount Kalaga hunting

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Cards are scattered across Leonida; a set only counts when it is whole, so collect with a checklist and finish three full sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: One hundred spots — treat it as a background task and tap WAiNK whenever you pass a new spot instead of grinding it in one go.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges cover the game's side tasks; 50 of them is a long grind — keep chipping away at the list and let the count build up across the playthrough.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Chain three shop robberies in one run while keeping the wanted level — plan a route with three close shops and a fast car.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: A new vehicle counts the first time you get in one — drive everything you see instead of sticking to one car.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Wait for a tight group of five, trigger Combat Focus, and drop them all before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal an aircraft at Vice City International and take off without filing a plan — expect the runway to get busy.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and stir up trouble — the trophy is about the tank, not a mission, so any Rhino will do.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Go in quiet — no alarms, nobody spotting you — and get out the same way.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Five vaults, each with a clean escape. Plan each one and leave fast — a failed escape does not count.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit a truck on the road, take the cash, and lose the heat — one clean job is enough.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: The map fills in as you travel across all 52 areas; sweep the regions you never visit for missions (the far corners and islands) to finish the last few.

sources.label: GTA Bay: GTA 6 Activities — Leonida regions

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: One operation per gang; learn which gang holds which turf and hit each one's operation once.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch: no launch-week guide confirmed what triggers this one. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but the exact spot and trigger were not confirmed when the game launched on 19 November 2026 — check the cited list for updates instead of chasing a guess.

sources.label: Output Lag: GTA 6 Trophy List — no confirmed method at launch

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch: no launch-week guide confirmed the trigger. The description describes smashing out of a vehicle showroom 'in classic style', but which showroom and what exactly counts were not confirmed at launch — check the cited list for updates.

sources.label: Output Lag: GTA 6 Trophy List — no confirmed method at launch

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — a full game there is the safe reading of the description.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This one is about the gym partnership: work out at the gym with both characters and build the partnership until it pays off — it takes regular gym work, not a single visit.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: PSN tracks a count toward 500 for this one — choices made across the game. Just play and choose; the count fills up through normal play.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch: no launch-week guide confirmed the trigger. The description ('Second time's the charm') hints at succeeding on a second attempt, but what exactly has to fail first and succeed second was not confirmed at launch — check the cited list for updates.

sources.label: Output Lag: GTA 6 Trophy List — no confirmed method at launch

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch: no launch-week guide confirmed the trigger. The description ('What the hell just happened?') points at some strange event, but no guide confirmed which one at launch — check the cited list for updates.

sources.label: Output Lag: GTA 6 Trophy List — no confirmed method at launch

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch: no launch-week guide confirmed the trigger. The name and description ('Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by') suggest knocking someone down with a melee drive-by, but the exact target and conditions were not confirmed at launch — check the cited list for updates.

sources.label: Output Lag: GTA 6 Trophy List — no confirmed method at launch

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Laundered money counts cumulatively — keep feeding marked bills to your contacts across the game until the $250,000 total is reached.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Cumulative spending — clothes, food, fuel, everything counts. It fills up on its own if you spend normally; check the total late in the game.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: All 8 of them, about $160,000 in total. Save up and buy them as you go; garages are also where you store the vehicles this guide's other trophies ask you to find.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Grab a vehicle, open the Scooter Bros app, register it, repeat — ten different vehicles in all.
